name: AI Featured Image
author: Amr Issa

sections.description:
AI Featured Image Generator creates AI-powered featured images right from the WordPress editor. Click “Generate Featured Image” on any post and the plugin builds a unique image from your post title, chosen style, and optional custom prompt, using OpenAI, Stability AI, or Grok/xAI on the free plan, or Google Gemini and Meta Muse on Pro.

Every image gets alt text automatically and an SEO-friendly filename based on your post title. Generate one at a time in the editor, in bulk, straight from the Posts list, inline in your content with the AI Image Generator block, or by asking an AI assistant such as Claude Desktop or Cursor through MCP. Everything is managed from one settings hub.

Video Walkthrough

Free Features

  • 3 free AI providers: OpenAI, Stability AI, and Grok/xAI (Google Gemini and Meta Muse available on Pro)
  • OpenAI models: GPT Image 2 (default): excels at text rendering in multiple languages, visual reasoning, multi-object scenes, transparent backgrounds, mask-based editing, and up to 4K output
  • Stability AI: Stable Image Core with 16 native style presets (Photographic, Cinematic, Anime, Digital Art, Comic Book, Fantasy Art, and more)
  • Grok/xAI: Grok Imagine Image: fast and affordable at $0.02 per image
  • 21 style presets: Common (None, Realistic, Artistic, Cartoon, Minimalist), Creative (Sketch, Watercolor, 3D Render, Pixel Art, Cyberpunk, Fantasy, Anime, Technicolor), and Trending (Toy Figure, Miniature World, Claymation, Cinematic, Lo-Fi Cozy, Vintage Instant Photo, Magazine Collage, Paper Cut)
  • Custom prompts: plus one-click Generate Prompt from Content, which crafts an AI-optimized prompt from your post title and body (OpenAI and Grok free; Gemini on Pro)
  • 7 image sizes with GPT Image 2 and 2.5: square, portrait, landscape, widescreen 16:9, vertical 9:16, ultra-wide 3:1, and tall banner 1:3
  • All aspect ratios: 9 for Stability AI and 9 for Grok, plus 2K resolution on Grok
  • Output control (OpenAI): WebP/PNG/JPEG format, compression slider (1–100), and Low/Medium/High generation quality (Extra High and Max on GPT Image 2.5, Pro)
  • Text control: allow or block text, captions, and words in generated images
  • Auto alt text: from the post title, the prompt, or a custom template with {title}, {prompt}, {style}, and {site_name} placeholders. with an option to preserve manual edits on regeneration
  • Bulk Generate: unlimited images for Posts and Pages that have no featured image yet, as many at once as you like
  • Generate from Post List: an “AI Featured Image” column on the Posts/Pages list with a one-click Generate/Regenerate link, so there is no need to open the editor
  • Inline images: the AI Image Generator block adds AI images anywhere in your Gutenberg content, with its own settings tab
  • AI assistants (MCP): connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code or VS Code and ask them in plain words, starting with “On ,” to make featured images, make any image for the Media Library, find posts and images, audit your images (missing alt text, size, format, blur, cut-off edges) and fix alt text, titles and captions. A 3-step setup on the AI Assistants tab, 20 assistant images on the free plan
  • Multisite compatible

Pro Features 🚀

  • Google Gemini: Nano Banana 2.1 (Google’s newest, fast and about half the price of Nano Banana 2), Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro) and Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash, deprecated by Google but still available): up to 4K resolution and 10 aspect ratios
  • Meta Muse (beta): Muse Image 1.0, Meta’s reasoning image model at $0.01 per image, with 9 aspect ratios and native WebP, PNG or JPEG output
  • Unlimited AI assistant images (MCP): plus Pro tools for assistants: set a featured image from the Media Library, insert an image into a post, upscale, remove background, rename images, convert JPG or PNG to WebP, and manage the Brand Kit (read it, change colours, tone and logo placement, preview it, stamp the logo onto existing featured images and undo that, or set it up from what the site already says about itself)
  • GPT Image 2.5 (OpenAI): GPT Image 2.5 Flare (fast, recommended) and GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (best detail), with Extra High and Max generation quality and a one-click “Retry with Sunburst” button in the post editor
  • Image upscaling (Stability AI): Conservative (faithful 4x), Creative (AI-enhanced 4K), or Fast (quick 4x), right from the post editor
  • Background removal (Stability AI): one click isolates the subject and saves a transparent PNG as your featured image
  • Advanced Stability AI models: Stable Image Ultra, SD 3.5 Large / Large Turbo / Medium / Flash, SD 3 Large / Large Turbo / Medium, and SDXL 1.0
  • Negative prompts (Stability AI): exclude unwanted elements, e.g. “blurry, watermark, text, low quality”
  • Grok Imagine Image 2.0: higher quality at $0.04 per image
  • More output formats: PNG/JPEG/WebP for Stability AI, and automatic WebP conversion for Gemini and Grok images
  • More Bulk Generate: any post type, filters for date range and thumbnail status, overwrite existing images, and the Brand Kit
  • Custom post types: enable generation for any public post type
  • Custom styles: create named styles with your own prompt descriptions, available in every style dropdown
  • Brand Kit: save your brand colors, a style description, tone, and avoid-rules, plus an optional reference image (used by Google Gemini) and a logo watermark (corners or centre, with size, opacity, margin and offset controls plus a live preview), applied automatically to every image you generate, with a per-image “Use Brand Kit” toggle to skip it

Want to unlock Google Gemini, Meta Muse, image upscaling, background removal, the Brand Kit, unlimited AI assistant images and more? Upgrade to Pro here.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • An API key for at least one provider:
    • OpenAI (free plan)
    • Stability AI (free plan)
    • Grok/xAI (free plan)
    • Google Gemini (Pro only)
    • Meta Muse (Pro only)
  • For AI assistants (MCP): WordPress 6.9 or higher and the free MCP Adapter plugin, installed in one click from the AI Assistants tab

External Services

This plugin connects to your chosen AI provider’s API to generate images. For every provider:

  • Your post title and content (or your custom prompt, and for Stability AI any negative prompt) are sent to the provider’s API when you generate an image
  • Your API key for that provider authenticates each request
  • Requests are only sent when you trigger generation: from the post editor, the Posts list, Bulk Generate, or the AI Image Generator block
  • “Generate Prompt from Content” sends your post title and body to the provider’s text API: gpt-6-luna (OpenAI), grok-4.3 (Grok), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Gemini, Pro), or Muse Spark 1.3 (Meta Muse, Pro)

OpenAI (Free & Pro): image generation and prompt generation.
Terms of Service | Privacy Policy | API Documentation

Stability AI (Free & Pro): image generation; for Pro users, upscaling and background removal also send your existing featured image file to Stability AI for processing.
Terms of Service | Privacy Policy | API Documentation

Grok / xAI (Free & Pro): image generation and prompt generation.
Terms of Service | Privacy Policy | API Documentation

Google Gemini (Pro only): image generation and prompt generation.
Terms of Service | Privacy Policy | API Documentation

Meta Muse (Pro only): image generation (Muse Image 1.0) and prompt generation (Muse Spark 1.3) through the Meta Model API.
Terms of Service | Acceptable Use Policy | Data Handling | API Documentation

AI assistants (MCP): no new third party. Your own assistant app (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code) connects to your site with a WordPress Application Password and calls the same providers above with your keys. Images are only generated when you ask the assistant.

Data usage: generated images are stored in your WordPress media library. No personal data is stored by the providers beyond what’s necessary for API processing. You are responsible for ensuring your content complies with the selected provider’s usage policies.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ai-featured-image-generator folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to AI Image in the admin menu to configure your API key and other settings
  4. The AI Image Generator block is available in the Gutenberg block inserter for adding inline images
sections.faq:
Do I need an API key?

Yes, for at least one provider. All free-plan providers have free tiers or pay-as-you-go pricing: OpenAI, Stability AI, Grok/xAI, Google Gemini (Pro only), or Meta Muse (Pro only).

How much does it cost?

The plugin is free; you pay your provider per image:

  • OpenAI: varies by model and generation quality (Low is the cheapest); see OpenAI pricing
  • Stability AI: Stable Image Core is roughly ~$0.003/image; other models vary; see Stability AI pricing
  • Grok/xAI: $0.02/image (Grok Imagine Image) or $0.04/image (Grok Imagine Image 2.0)
  • Google Gemini (Pro): Nano Banana 2.1, Gemini 3.1 Flash and 3 Pro vary by resolution
  • Meta Muse (Pro): $0.01/image

Can I switch between providers?

Yes. Select your provider and enter its API key in the plugin settings. The page shows only the options relevant to your selection. Free users can switch between OpenAI, Stability AI, and Grok/xAI; Pro adds Google Gemini and Meta Muse.

Is there a limit to how many images I can generate?

Only your API plan’s quota with your chosen provider. The plugin generates one image per request. The free plan has one lifetime cap: 20 images requested by AI assistants (MCP). Pro removes it. Everything else, including Bulk Generate, has no plugin limit.

What AI models are available?

OpenAI (Free & Pro): GPT Image 2 (default, with strong text rendering and visual reasoning). Pro adds GPT Image 2.5 Flare (up to 50% faster than GPT Image 2 with sharper detail) and GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (the most detailed), both with Extra High and Max generation quality.

Stability AI: Stable Image Core (free): fast, high quality, best value. Pro adds Stable Image Ultra (best quality), SD 3.5 Large / Large Turbo / Medium / Flash, SD 3 Large / Large Turbo / Medium, and SDXL 1.0 (legacy).

Grok / xAI: Grok Imagine Image (free, $0.02/image) and Grok Imagine Image 2.0 (Pro, $0.04/image).

Google Gemini (Pro only): Nano Banana 2.1 (1K/2K/4K, the default), Gemini 3.1 Flash Image (1K/2K/4K, deprecated by Google) and Gemini 3 Pro Image (best quality, 1K/2K/4K). All support 10 aspect ratios.

Meta Muse (Pro only, beta): Muse Image 1.0, Meta’s in-house reasoning image model. New and not yet widely tested, so please report anything odd. 9 aspect ratios, up to 1600px, $0.01 per image.

What styles are available?

21 built-in styles that work with all providers: None, Realistic, Artistic, Cartoon, Minimalist, Sketch, Watercolor, 3D Render, Pixel Art, Cyberpunk, Fantasy, Anime, and Technicolor, plus the Trending group: Toy Figure, Miniature World, Claymation, Cinematic, Lo-Fi Cozy, Vintage Instant Photo, Magazine Collage, and Paper Cut.

With Stability AI you also get a Stability Presets group of 16 native API-level presets: Photographic, Cinematic, Anime, Digital Art, Comic Book, Fantasy Art, 3D Model, Analog Film, Enhance, Isometric, Line Art, Low Poly, Neon Punk, Origami, Pixel Art, and Tile Texture.

Pro users can also create unlimited custom styles (see below).

Can I create my own custom styles? (Pro)

Yes. Go to AI Images → Settings → Brand & Styles → Custom Styles, click “Add Style”, and enter a name plus a prompt description (e.g. “in a dreamy impressionist style”). Custom styles appear in all style dropdowns and work exactly like built-in styles.

What is the Brand Kit? (Pro)

One global set of brand rules that keeps every AI image on-brand. Go to AI Images → Settings → Brand & Styles and save up to 3 brand colors, a style description, a tone, and avoid-rules; optionally add a reference image (used by Google Gemini to match your visual style) and a logo watermark with position (four corners or centre), size, opacity, margin and horizontal/vertical offset controls, with a live preview you can drag to place the logo. The kit is applied automatically wherever you generate: post editor, Bulk Generate, the Posts list, and the AI Image Generator block. The post editor, Bulk Generate, and the block each have a “Use Brand Kit” checkbox you can uncheck for a one-off image; the Posts list always applies the kit.

What image sizes and aspect ratios are supported?

  • OpenAI: 7 sizes with GPT Image 2 and 2.5: 1024×1024 (1:1), 1024×1536 (portrait), 1536×1024 (landscape), 1792×1024 (16:9), 1024×1792 (9:16), 1920×640 (3:1), and 640×1920 (1:3)
  • Stability AI: 9 ratios (1:1, 16:9, 21:9, 2:3, 3:2, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 9:21)
  • Grok: 9 ratios (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 2:1, 1:2)
  • Gemini (Pro): 10 ratios (1:1, 2:3, 3:2, 3:4, 4:3, 4:5, 5:4, 9:16, 16:9, 21:9): 1K/2K/4K on Nano Banana 2.1, Gemini 3.1 Flash and 3 Pro
  • Meta Muse (Pro): 9 ratios (1:1, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4, 3:2, 2:3, 2:1, 1:2)

Can I upscale my featured image? (Pro)

Yes, with a Stability AI API key. Once a featured image is set, a “Stability AI Tools” panel appears in the post editor with three modes: Conservative (faithful 4x), Creative (AI-enhanced 4K), and Fast (quick 4x). Conservative and Creative process asynchronously and may take up to ~3 minutes; the result automatically becomes your new featured image.

Can I remove the background from my featured image? (Pro)

Yes, from the same “Stability AI Tools” panel. Click “Remove Background” and Stability AI isolates the subject and saves a transparent PNG as your featured image, which suits product shots and portraits.

What is a negative prompt? (Stability AI, Pro)

Text that tells Stability AI what not to include, e.g. “blurry, watermark, text, low quality”. Set defaults in AI Images → Settings → Featured Images (and the Inline Images tab). Negative prompts have no effect with OpenAI, Gemini, or Grok.

What output formats are supported?

  • OpenAI: WebP (recommended), PNG, or JPEG
  • Stability AI: PNG free; Pro adds JPEG and WebP
  • Grok: JPEG free; Pro adds WebP (converted after generation)
  • Gemini (Pro): PNG default, or WebP (converted after generation)
  • Meta Muse (Pro): WebP (default), PNG, or JPEG, returned directly by the API

Because the Gemini and Grok APIs return PNG/JPEG, the plugin converts to WebP using your server’s image library (ImageMagick or GD).

Why was my image saved as PNG or JPEG instead of WebP?

WebP conversion for Gemini and Grok needs a WebP-capable image library on your server (GD with WebP, or ImageMagick with the WebP delegate). If it’s missing, the plugin safely falls back to the provider’s native format and shows a notice with the reason. Generation never fails. Ask your host to enable WebP if needed. OpenAI WebP is unaffected because the API returns it directly.

How does quality control work?

  • OpenAI: Output Compression slider (1–100, default 90) plus a Low/Medium/High generation quality tier (Extra High and Max on GPT Image 2.5, Pro)
  • Stability AI: quality is inherent to the model you choose
  • Grok: 1K or 2K resolution
  • Gemini (Pro): 1K/2K/4K on Nano Banana 2.1, 3.1 Flash and 3 Pro
  • Inline images (all providers): Automatic Quality Optimization picks quality and resolution based on the image’s display size in your content

Can I generate images inside the Gutenberg editor?

Yes. Add the “AI Image Generator” block from the Media category, enter a prompt, and generate images anywhere in your content. The block supports the same providers, styles, and aspect ratios as featured images; configure defaults in the Inline Images settings tab.

How does auto alt text work?

Every AI image (featured, inline, or bulk) automatically gets alt text in the media library. Configure it under AI Images → Settings → General → Alt Text: choose the post title (default), the generation prompt, or a custom template with {title}, {prompt}, {style}, and {site_name} placeholders. e.g. {title} - {style} style - {site_name}. By default, manually edited alt text is preserved on regeneration; enable “Overwrite on Regeneration” to always refresh it.

How does “Generate Prompt from Content” work?

Click “Generate Prompt from Content” in the post editor and AI writes an image prompt from your post title and body. It’s saved to the post and pre-filled in the Custom Prompt field so you can review or edit before generating. The same option exists in Bulk Generate, creating a unique prompt per post.

Text model per provider: gpt-6-luna (OpenAI), grok-4.3 (Grok), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Gemini, Pro), Muse Spark 1.3 (Meta Muse, Pro). Stability AI has no text API, so the button shows a notice when it’s the active provider.

Can I generate images from Claude, Cursor or another AI assistant? (MCP)

Yes. Go to AI Images → Settings → AI Assistants and follow the 3 steps: install the free MCP Adapter plugin (one click), create a key (one click), and connect your app with the ready-made config. Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code and VS Code are covered with step-by-step instructions, and the tab ticks step 3 by itself the first time your assistant calls the site, which costs nothing. Then start each request with “On” and your site name, for example “On My Site, make a featured image for my latest post”. That one rule works in every app and keeps several sites apart. The assistant can only do what your WordPress user can do, and only the plugin’s image tools are exposed. Free sites get 20 assistant images plus finding, auditing and alt text; Pro is unlimited and adds the tools below. On a Free site the Pro tools still show up, but answer with an upgrade link instead of running. Needs WordPress 6.9 or newer. claude.ai in the browser and ChatGPT cannot connect yet because they need an OAuth sign-in that the MCP Adapter does not provide.

What can the assistant do on my site? (MCP)

Free:

  • Make images: a featured image for a post (with a prompt, style, shape, provider or model of your choice) or any image for the Media Library. 20 images in total.
  • Find: posts, pages and any other post type by title, author, category, tag, date, or whether they have a featured image; read a post to write a better prompt; find images in the Media Library by name.
  • Image audits: count and list images by format, shape, pixel size, file size, upload date, missing alt text, blur or cut-off edges, across posts of any type or the whole Media Library; measure one image for sharpness and cut-off edges; look at a preview to judge the picture itself.
  • Image text: change an image’s title, alt text, caption or description.

Pro adds unlimited images and:

  • Image tools: rename an image (every post keeps pointing at the right file), convert JPG or PNG to WebP (every post switches to the lighter copy), upscale, or remove the background.
  • Place images: set a Media Library image as a featured image, or insert it into a post.
  • Brand: read and change the Brand Kit (colours, tone, description, avoid list, reference image), pick and place the logo, preview the kit, stamp the logo onto the featured images posts already have (no AI call) and undo it, find posts whose image predates the current kit, and set the kit up from the site name, tagline, theme colours and logo.

Examples: “On My Site, add featured images to every post in Recipes that is missing one”, “On My Site, which pages have JPG images with no alt text?”, “On My Site, look at the featured image on post 123 and tell me if anything is cut off”, “On My Site, set my brand colours to navy and gold, then show me a test image”, “On My Site, look at my site and suggest a brand kit”, “On My Site, which posts still have images from before my brand kit changed?”, “On My Site, add my logo to every featured image in Recipes”.

Does it work with custom post types? (Pro)

Yes. Go to AI Images → Settings → General → Availability, check the post types you want, and save. The generator panel then appears in the editor for those post types. Free users are limited to Posts and Pages.

  • 21 style presets: Common (None, Realistic, Artistic, Cartoon, Minimalist), Creative (Sketch, Watercolor, 3D Render, Pixel Art, Cyberpunk, Fantasy, Anime, Technicolor), and Trending (Toy Figure, Miniature World, Claymation, Cinematic, Lo-Fi Cozy, Vintage Instant Photo, Magazine Collage, Paper Cut)
  • Custom prompts: plus one-click Generate Prompt from Content, which crafts an AI-optimized prompt from your post title and body (OpenAI and Grok free; Gemini on Pro)
  • 7 image sizes with GPT Image 2 and 2.5: square, portrait, landscape, widescreen 16:9, vertical 9:16, ultra-wide 3:1, and tall banner 1:3
  • All aspect ratios: 9 for Stability AI and 9 for Grok, plus 2K resolution on Grok
  • Output control (OpenAI): WebP/PNG/JPEG format, compression slider (1–100), and Low/Medium/High generation quality (Extra High and Max on GPT Image 2.5, Pro)
  • Text control: allow or block text, captions, and words in generated images
  • Auto alt text: from the post title, the prompt, or a custom template with {title}, {prompt}, {style}, and {site_name} placeholders. with an option to preserve manual edits on regeneration
  • Bulk Generate: unlimited images for Posts and Pages that have no featured image yet, as many at once as you like
  • Generate from Post List: an “AI Featured Image” column on the Posts/Pages list with a one-click Generate/Regenerate link, so there is no need to open the editor
  • Inline images: the AI Image Generator block adds AI images anywhere in your Gutenberg content, with its own settings tab
  • AI assistants (MCP): connect Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code or VS Code and ask them in plain words, starting with “On ,” to make featured images, make any image for the Media Library, find posts and images, audit your images (missing alt text, size, format, blur, cut-off edges) and fix alt text, titles and captions. A 3-step setup on the AI Assistants tab, 20 assistant images on the free plan
  • Multisite compatible

Pro Features 🚀

  • Google Gemini: Nano Banana 2.1 (Google’s newest, fast and about half the price of Nano Banana 2), Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro) and Nano Banana 2 (Gemini 3.1 Flash, deprecated by Google but still available): up to 4K resolution and 10 aspect ratios
  • Meta Muse (beta): Muse Image 1.0, Meta’s reasoning image model at $0.01 per image, with 9 aspect ratios and native WebP, PNG or JPEG output
  • Unlimited AI assistant images (MCP): plus Pro tools for assistants: set a featured image from the Media Library, insert an image into a post, upscale, remove background, rename images, convert JPG or PNG to WebP, and manage the Brand Kit (read it, change colours, tone and logo placement, preview it, stamp the logo onto existing featured images and undo that, or set it up from what the site already says about itself)
  • GPT Image 2.5 (OpenAI): GPT Image 2.5 Flare (fast, recommended) and GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst (best detail), with Extra High and Max generation quality and a one-click “Retry with Sunburst” button in the post editor
  • Image upscaling (Stability AI): Conservative (faithful 4x), Creative (AI-enhanced 4K), or Fast (quick 4x), right from the post editor
  • Background removal (Stability AI): one click isolates the subject and saves a transparent PNG as your featured image
  • Advanced Stability AI models: Stable Image Ultra, SD 3.5 Large / Large Turbo / Medium / Flash, SD 3 Large / Large Turbo / Medium, and SDXL 1.0
  • Negative prompts (Stability AI): exclude unwanted elements, e.g. “blurry, watermark, text, low quality”
  • Grok Imagine Image 2.0: higher quality at $0.04 per image
  • More output formats: PNG/JPEG/WebP for Stability AI, and automatic WebP conversion for Gemini and Grok images
  • More Bulk Generate: any post type, filters for date range and thumbnail status, overwrite existing images, and the Brand Kit
  • Custom post types: enable generation for any public post type
  • Custom styles: create named styles with your own prompt descriptions, available in every style dropdown
  • Brand Kit: save your brand colors, a style description, tone, and avoid-rules, plus an optional reference image (used by Google Gemini) and a logo watermark (corners or centre, with size, opacity, margin and offset controls plus a live preview), applied automatically to every image you generate, with a per-image “Use Brand Kit” toggle to skip it

Want to unlock Google Gemini, Meta Muse, image upscaling, background removal, the Brand Kit, unlimited AI assistant images and more? Upgrade to Pro here.

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.8 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • An API key for at least one provider:
    • OpenAI (free plan)
    • Stability AI (free plan)
    • Grok/xAI (free plan)
    • Google Gemini (Pro only)
    • Meta Muse (Pro only)
  • For AI assistants (MCP): WordPress 6.9 or higher and the free MCP Adapter plugin, installed in one click from the AI Assistants tab

External Services

This plugin connects to your chosen AI provider’s API to generate images. For every provider:

  • Your post title and content (or your custom prompt, and for Stability AI any negative prompt) are sent to the provider’s API when you generate an image
  • Your API key for that provider authenticates each request
  • Requests are only sent when you trigger generation: from the post editor, the Posts list, Bulk Generate, or the AI Image Generator block
  • “Generate Prompt from Content” sends your post title and body to the provider’s text API: gpt-6-luna (OpenAI), grok-4.3 (Grok), Gemini 3.6 Flash (Gemini, Pro), or Muse Spark 1.3 (Meta Muse, Pro)

OpenAI (Free & Pro): image generation and prompt generation.

Meta Muse (Pro only): image generation (Muse Image 1.0) and prompt generation (Muse Spark 1.3) through the Meta Model API.

AI assistants (MCP): no new third party. Your own assistant app (Claude Desktop, Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code) connects to your site with a WordPress Application Password and calls the same providers above with your keys. Images are only generated when you ask the assistant.

Data usage: generated images are stored in your WordPress media library. No personal data is stored by the providers beyond what’s necessary for API processing. You are responsible for ensuring your content complies with the selected provider’s usage policies.
